gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-khojki: A tube-like line holds its thickness through every bend in Galaxy, dense and commanding. Noto Sans Khojki takes the opposite job, with a large, clear eye on each e and exits wide enough to pass light.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Commanding is how Galaxy comes across, its marker-like line holding the same weight from letter to letter and across a dense lowercase band. gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Cosmic is the mood Galaxy sets, with hairlines nowhere to be found and loose, spacious letterfit. Noto Sans Palmyrene then carries the text, its curves stopping short instead of closing, and its compressed ascenders keep lines compact and modern.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Galaxy reads like following one single thread, loose and spacious, with a dense lowercase band that stays commanding. Noto Sans Samaritan does the plain sans work, hefty and full of daylight.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Galaxy has zero thick and thin contrast anywhere. That uniform line gives it real presence in large display lines, while Noto Sans Sharada handles text in sans-serif form with open c forms and bulky lowercase.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa reads approachably, with wide inviting round letters. Galaxy comes in above it with curves and stems in lockstep, and that cosmic, commanding build looks best set large over a few words.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tc: Cosmic and loose, Galaxy keeps an unbroken line width with no brush-style swell anywhere in it. And Noto Sans TC supplies the approachable half, its large open counters and outward-opening curves making the strongest pull in this pairing.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Stroke thickness never varies in Galaxy, which gives its dense lowercase band a commanding, cosmic look. But Noto Sans Tifinagh is happy at a modest size, where its inflated, rounded bowls fill the line without crowding.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Commanding from the first glance, Galaxy holds a stylus-at-fixed-pressure stroke across every letter. Noto Sans Tirhuta is the one to enlarge, since its dominant x-height and cut-back terminals stay open, whereas a shrunken Galaxy would lose its presence.
